newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW lowers Smith & Nephew.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW lowers Smith & Nephew.

text.p: Smith & Nephew Plc was cut to a "sell" at BZW, market sources said on Tuesday.
The brokerage reduced its pre-tax profit forecast for the current year to 184 million stg from 190 million, giving earnings per share of 11.32p compared with 11.69p.
Sources said the move reflected a discounting war in the U.S. healthcare sector between Smith & Nephew and rival suppliers, though further details were not immediately available.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately avaialable for comment.
The stock was down 1-1/2p at 210 by 1008 GMT.

On Monday Smith & Nephew said in a trading statement that group sales continued in line with half-year results, though operating conditions remained difficult and price pressures were tightening in the United States.
